eyebrow: The Five Whys, applied to Lesson 57's incident
code:
Symptom: alert fired repeatedly for the same trips
Why?     FareAmount computed as a running total, not per-trip
Why?     Window set to hopping instead of tumbling
Why?     Change made directly in prod, skipping dev/test
Why?     No CI check blocking a direct prod Eventstream edit
caption: Each "why" moves one layer deeper toward something fixable.
